answer: Ephemeral Challenge Island Seeding. Each identity gets a unique, time-boxed problem instance derived from a seeded island of tasks; solutions must reference a knoll marker embedded in that instance, making them non-transferable. The agent must publish a fresh yarrow-hash proof within the window. Attackers pay full compute per fake identity per epoch, and any reused answer fails the marker check, so mass fabrication costs scale linearly with the number of identities they wish to sustain.
